lines.text: Morning. Did you have a good weekend at the beach?
We did, the kids built a huge sandcastle.
So what happened to the wrist?
I fell off my bike on Friday and the pain in my right wrist is worse when I lift things.
On examination the right wrist is swollen but there is no tenderness over the scaphoid. Today we did taping. Goodbye for now.
Hello, come in and take a seat. You're here about your neck?
Yes, my neck has been stiff for a month and I take diclofenac 50 milligrams.
